name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This gives keyboard users a clear, visible indicator without overwhelming the interface, balancing visibility and subtlety. The glow ensures visibility on busy backgrounds while the solid ring maintains sharpness. Trade-off: slightly thicker rings may reduce space for content in tight layouts, but this is a worthwhile compromise for accessibility.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less precise," it’s unusable for users who rely on magnification. A 1px ring with a 1px glow at 30% opacity risks fading into the background for low-vision users, especially on patterned backgrounds. Settle it with WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 (Focus Appearance) testing at 200% zoom: if it fails, default to a 3px ring with no glow.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 1-pixel solid focus ring with a 1-pixel outer glow at 30% opacity. This meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1 by ensuring the indicator remains visible at 125% zoom without bleeding or distortion. The glow provides enough contrast for low-vision users while the solid ring keeps precision. Trade-off: on high-contrast patterned backgrounds, the glow may fade slightly—accept this for universal usability.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring + 30% glow still risks disappearing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds—WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1 only guarantees visibility at 125% zoom, not against visual noise. A 1.5px ring with a 1px glow at 25% opacity sharpens edges without bleeding, tested at 200% zoom. Settle it with a live contrast checker against a checkerboard pattern at 125% and 200% zoom.

name: Access
text:
DECISION: Adopt a 1.5px solid focus ring with a 1px outer glow at 25% opacity, tested at 200% zoom against high-contrast patterned backgrounds to meet WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1.

Result: A focus indicator that remains sharp, visible, and non-distracting across all zoom levels and backgrounds.
